prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square mature painterly mythology encyclopedia artwork. ACHERI, Kumaon Himalayan girl spirit. One young girl-shaped apparition with ordinary coherent human face and anatomy, dark loose hair and a modest plain faded grey mountain village tunic with long skirt and shawl, standing quietly on a stony Himalayan mountaintop ridge at dusk. Twilight sky, layered southern Himalayan peaks, alpine scrub. A long deep dark natural-looking shadow extends from her across empty rocky ground, emphasizing the documented dangerous shadow without showing any sick child or attack. Subtle fading robe edges signal a spirit. Solemn uncanny expression, no distorted face, ghost tentacles, fangs, claws, horns, wings, pointed ears, white demon eyes, blood or red costume. Elegant detailed atmospheric brushwork, restrained antique-gold light, deep forest-green shadows. Subject head and hands fully inside frame. No text, signature, border, watermark, nudity, extra anatomy or gore.
visual_requirements: Uncanny shadow without invented anatomy or visible victim

historical_basis: Kumaon Acheri is a girl spirit living on mountain peaks and descending at night to revel, whose shadow is believed to cause illness. Retains girl-shaped human anatomy without invented horror traits; no inaccurate red-clothing protection shown.
